x: Vic Townsend and Gerry Cameron showed what pack training can do, and Don Bartliff walked well for his first "Open" in Belgrave colours. What? no Belgrave man or team in the handicap?---shame! perhaps they are saving it!

DAVE DE BONDI and VIC TOWNSEND both send their regards to all Bels. It is pleasing to hear (via Harry Shields) that our Past President ALF TAYLOR and his wife JENNY are both well in their Somerset retreat.

Overall a disappointing result for the Bels but a trip not to be forgotten in a hurry. Other Belgravians making an appearance were Vic Townsend who was 2nd in a veterans race and Dave De Bondi over from Australia to watch.
